contract: v9 INPUT-STAGE PREREG, DRAFT (NOT FROZEN). Option (a): re-test the v8 R1-R6/LMC timing fit with the flash intensity pinned from the source instead of v8's assumed encoder 330. Freezing is done by the orchestrator after audit; until then nothing here may be run as a fit.
status: DRAFT - not frozen; no fit may run against this file
label: EXPLORATORY; post hoc to v8 F1_R. Inherits S1-A3 photoreceptor gain/adaptation (G, Ka, tau_a: FIT REJECTED in S1), fixed n_stages = 4, the dead-time ring structure and leak40 (hypothetical). NO science-rule changes: the adaptation model and the dead-time structure are untouched (those are options b/c, not this arm).
hypothesis: v8 failed at the R stage (F1_R) under an ASSUMED flash level (encoder 330). If the only defect were the flash level, then with the flash pinned to the source-consistent saturation threshold E_sat (the level most lenient to a slow R peak), fitting R1-R6 tau_p0/Kt and L1/L2 membrane/Ih timing reproduces Drosophila R and LMC flash timing (G1-G5), and the UNCHANGED v6 leak40 medulla then predicts the Behnia 2014 medulla filter timing.

prediction_stated_before_freeze.basis: qualification/v9/V9_probe.json section C: at E_sat no point of a 72-point grid over the free photoreceptor box passes the R stage; G3_R (R onset <= 10 ms) holds only for tau_p0 <= 2 ms (flash R tp 11-17 ms) and G1 (tp 23-30 ms) only at tau_p0 = 8 ms (onset 13-14 ms); n(G1 and G3_R) = 0. G4 at BG-4 IS reachable (16/72), unlike the open question raised before the probe; G4 at both backgrounds at 2/72.
prediction_stated_before_freeze.information_value: v9 tests one sub-question: is v8's F1_R explained by the flash-level assumption? A FAIL at E_sat holds over the whole source-consistent range (time to peak is non-increasing with level at base and at all four box corners, V9_probe.json A). If F1_R recurs, the remaining candidates are the fixed n=4 cascade, fixed D/ring structure and S1-A3 adaptation, i.e. options (b)/(c), which need their own owner go.
prediction_stated_before_freeze.caveat: the probe grid is coarse; Powell may find interior points the grid misses. The prediction is not a gate and does not change any rule.

flash_intensity_pin.citation: Mansour et al. 2026 Nat Commun (PMC13144400), Supplementary Note I.1, Supplementary Information PDF p.3 para 2 ('a saturating 10-ms bright light flash, recorded in vivo at 25 C'); Supp. Fig. 1 legend, PDF p.4 ('10-ms white light flash following brief (5-15 s) dark adaptation')
flash_intensity_pin.verdict: NOT STATED UNAMBIGUOUSLY: no photon flux, irradiance, ND or LED drive level is given. Bounded range: lower = saturating (E_sat); upper = uncalibrated rig maximum (logI 0), nominal engine stand-in encoder 10,000.
flash_intensity_pin.conversion: engine I in JH2001 BG0 units, encoder_to_intensity 0.01 (fixed). E_sat = lowest level of {10^(k/2), k=0..8} whose R flash peak >= 0.90 x peak at 10,000, evaluated once at base S1-A3 with D = 7.
flash_intensity_pin.E_sat_meaning: encoder 100 = 1 x JH2001 BG0 (~3e6 effective photons/s) for 10 ms; base R peak 47.5 mV vs 50.9 mV at 10,000 (0.93)
flash_intensity_pin.E_sat_box_dependence_disclosed: E_sat at box corners: 31.6 (tau_p0 0.5), 316 (tau_p0 20, Kt 0.001), 1000 (tau_p0 20, Kt 100). It is NOT refitted; G0 guards it.
flash_intensity_pin.not_tuned: E_sat was fixed by the pre-stated rule; it was not chosen by matching the 25.5 ms target.

targets: identical to qualification/v8/V8_input_prereg_v3.json 'targets' (flash R 25.5 ms, LMC 12.2 ms, latency 6.5 +- 1.5 ms, kernel tp 40/20 ms at BG-4/BG0, D 10 ms at BG0; sources Mansour 2026 Supp. Fig. 1b and Juusola & Hardie 2001)

free_parameters.continuous: identical to v8 v3 (R1-R6 tau_p0_ms 0.5-20 log, Kt 0.001-100 log; L1/L2 tau_m_ms 1-200 log, ih_g 0-3, ih_tau_ms 5-1000 log, ih_vh_mV -80..-30)
free_parameters.dead_time_note: kept from v8 v3 (no change to the dead-time structure). Probe bounds (V9_probe.json B, engine substep 0.1 ms, graded-release delay 1.8 ms, +1 ms read offset): R onset = D+1; L onset = D+2 at w = -50 and D+3 at w = -9.6 and -5. The frozen cutout's R->L weights sum to -9.63 (L1) and -9.08 (L2) (V8 addendum 1), so G3_L is feasible only at D = 7; D = 8 is retained for comparability with v8 and can pass the R stage only. G5 (D 7-13) excludes D <= 6.

fixed: G, Ka, tau_a, n_stages, encoder_to_intensity, the release synapses and the medulla (as v8)
protocols: v8 protocols (scripts/v8/v8_input.py) unchanged EXCEPT the flash level: v8_input.FLASH_LEVEL = E_sat = 100 (was 330). 10 s dark, 10 ms flash, 100 ms record; noise at BG-4 and BG0 as v8.
optimiser: identical to v8 v3: Powell, 6 starts per D (start 0 = base clipped, 5 LHS draws, seed 8010), 12 runs, maxfev 2000, 2 h wall cap per run, >= 6 of 12 completed; CPU only, NUMBA 1 thread, <= 4 processes, nice, taskset -c 0-3
compute_budget: as v8 v3: ~13 core-h, ~3.5 h wall at <= 4 cores

training.G0_saturation_validity: NEW in v9 (consequence of the pin, not a timing gate): at the run's final parameters and D, the R flash peak at E_sat is >= 0.90 x the peak at encoder 10,000. A run failing G0 is reported as 'flash not saturating at its own parameters' and cannot be TRAIN_PASS.
training.G1: flash R1-R6 time to peak 23-30 ms (printed range +-1 ms)
training.G2: flash L1 AND L2 time to peak 10-16 ms AND earlier than R
training.G3_L: L1 and L2 onsets 4-10 ms AND |L - R| <= 3 ms
training.G4: R kernel time to peak within 25 % of 40 ms (BG-4) and 20 ms (BG0) at each evaluable background, AND faster at BG0 when both are evaluable
training.R_STAGE: G0 and G1 and G3_R and G4 and G5
training.TRAIN_PASS: R_STAGE and LMC_STAGE on the run's own parameters
training.gate_values: G1-G5 numeric windows are UNCHANGED from v8 v3; they come from the data, not from the probe. The probe informs only the feasibility statement, the D-grid note and the stated prediction.

heldout.evaluated: Behnia 2014 (Mi1, Tm3, Tm1, Tm2 filters) is evaluated ONLY if TRAIN_PASS, once, on the frozen params_v9.json; otherwise it is NOT run and nothing is claimed about the medulla
heldout.gates: H1, H2, HELDOUT_PASS identical to v8 v3 acceptance.heldout
heldout.label: independent data (other lab, cells, method) but NOT analyst-blind (the analyst has seen Behnia in v7/v8)

outcomes.NOT_EVALUABLE: step 0 declares the arm not evaluable, or fewer than 6 of 12 runs completed: no claim; stop
outcomes.F1_R: no completed run passes the R stage (G0, G1, G3_R, G4, G5): with the flash at the source-consistent saturation threshold, the photoreceptor model (fixed n=4, fixed D ring, S1-A3 adaptation) does not reproduce Drosophila R timing; because time to peak falls with level, this holds for every source-consistent flash level. The flash-level explanation of v8 F1_R is rejected. R->LMC is NOT tested.
outcomes.F1_LMC: some run passes the R stage but none passes both: as v8 F1_LMC, conditional on E_sat, fixed release synapse and 1.8 ms release delay
outcomes.F2_propagation: TRAIN_PASS but HELDOUT_PASS false: remaining error is in the medulla/synapse model
outcomes.PASS: TRAIN_PASS and HELDOUT_PASS: exploratory and CONDITIONAL on the real flash being near saturation threshold (a brighter real flash would make R peak earlier); any S3 needs a separate owner go
outcomes.always_reported: all runs, both stage verdicts and G0 per run, all gates, step-0 smoke
